title: Freeze the selected record as provenance in 138 more replay checks (no new κ)
body:
## What changes

This follows up #5410. It fixes 138 more of my research packages whose replays fail on main because a frontier file changed under them. #5410's search missed them: their `TASK.json` author field is `jwr`, and their verifiers use different code patterns.

**136 packages** pinned `certificates/selected-result.json` as a live `input`. In each:

- **`SOURCES.json`:** that one row changes from `"usage": "input"` to `"usage": "provenance"`. The blob and SHA256 stay the same.
- **`verify.py`:**
  - The hard-coded live hash check of the record is removed.
  - The record is dropped from the expected live-input inventory.
  - The live `json.loads(...selected-result.json...)` is replaced by the pinned record's value, `{"kappa": "836330098538459/500000000000000000"}`. All 136 pin the same blob, `b1fea0c9`. Some packages use κ in their arithmetic (e.g. `saving = kappa / (1 - kappa)`, "above the selected kappa"), so freezing it rather than deleting the read leaves **every downstream check unchanged**.
- `VERIFY.json` still lists the record in `inputs`, so a frontier change still triggers these replays, and they now pass.

**2 packages** needed small manual changes:

- `rank7-v45-margin`: both the record and `docs/research/research-family-status.md` were live inputs. Both become provenance, and their live checks are dropped.
- `selected-record-parse-cache`: the record stays the experiment's payload. Its one-digit mutation no longer hard-codes the old decimal. The README sentence is updated.

`RESULT.json` files, results and all other pins are unchanged.

## Why

The [research package guide](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/main/docs/research/research-package-guide.md) says: "The original card and selected record are historical provenance in Git, so future priority changes do not invalidate a package." `scripts/research_package.py` checks provenance rows at `base_commit` through Git.

## Validation

All 138 packages were run on this branch (main d277c9782 + 2 commits), with CPython 3.12:

- `python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package P`: 138/138 `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`.
- `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package P` (full registered replay, including `test_verify.py`): **138/138 pass**. Before this change, all 138 failed with `working source drift`.

## Not included

- **3 of my packages are still blocked upstream:** `selected-odd-prime-unit-root`, `selected-unit-root-tape-boundary` and `selected-unit-weight-reversal`. They run the vendored loader of `research/physical-ordinary-interchange`, which is another author's package. That loader validates the live selected record, and that package's own replay fails on main for the same reason. They need that package fixed first, so I left them unchanged here.
- **8 of my archive and intake-audit packages** pin live ledger or status files (`pr-ledger`, `pr-intake-decisions`, `current-status`, `research-family-status`, `CONTRIBUTORS.md`). Their checks quote those files' contents, so I will review each one separately in a follow-up.
- About 21 other authors' packages show the same live-κ pattern. They are not touched.

This is replay maintenance only. No κ, frontier or mathematical claim changes.
